Form No. 3
88,000/1.35

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No...........
Special Branch S.2.
REPORT
Date February 25, 1936

Subject Newspaper man of British nationality named Holmes.

Made by D.C. Jones Forwarded by I.B. Rao D.I.

With reference to the attached enquiry, I have ascertained
that an English journalist named Holmes came to Shanghai early
in 1932, shortly after the outbreak of Sino-Japanese hostilities
in Chapei. He was a man of about 32 years of age and was believed
to have registered at the Palace Hotel. As, unfortunately, the
guest register for that year is incomplete, there is no proof
that he did actually reside at the Palace Hotel during his stay
in Shanghai.

Holmes is alleged to have stated that he represented a
German newspaper. He was in Shanghai for only a short while
and then left for Manchuria. It is understood that from
Manchuria he travelled on to Europe via Siberia.

"B", whom I interviewed regarding the above in accordance
with the instructions of the D.C. Special Branch, states that
he knows nothing of Holmes.

D.C. Special Branch D.S.
C. Jones

S2,
Please inform "B." Holmes is unknown
Addis above J.W.S Thanks File
Sir, Your instructions have been complied with C. Jones
I.B.R. 26/2. 26 FEB. 1936

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案编号...........
特别支部 S.2.
报告
日期：1936年2月25日

事由：一名名为霍姆斯（Holmes）的英籍报人。

呈报人：警司琼斯（D.C. Jones） 转呈人：督察长拉奥（I.B. Rao）

关于所附查询事项，经查证，一名名为霍姆斯的英国记者于1932年初，即闸北中日战事爆发后不久抵达上海。该人年龄约32岁，据信曾在华懋饭店（Palace Hotel）登记入住。惟因该年度住客登记簿不幸残缺不全，故无证据证明其在沪期间确实居住于华懋饭店。

据称，霍姆斯曾声称其代表一家德国报纸。他在上海仅停留短暂时间，随后前往满洲。据悉，他从满洲经西伯利亚前往欧洲。

本人遵照特别支部警司之指示，就上述事项询问了“B”，其表示对霍姆斯一无所知。

特别支部警司 D.S.
C. 琼斯

S2，
请通知“B”。霍姆斯此人无人知晓
艾迪斯（Addis）同上 J.W.S 谢谢 归档
先生，已遵示办理 C. 琼斯
I.B.R. 2月26日。1936年2月26日

FM. 1
Memorandum.
POLICE FORCE,
MUNICIPAL COUNCIL.
Shanghai, 12. 2. 1936.
To. S 2,
Please endeavour to
establish the identity
and whereabouts while in
Shanghai of a newspaper
man of English nationality
named Holmes who was in
Shanghai in 1928 and 1929.
It is said that Holmes has
worked for communist
newspapers in Moscow,
Berlin and London and
while here was in close touch
with Chinese communist circles.
Inquiries showed he worked very
discreetly.
JH
DS. Jones.
13/2/36.

备忘录。
警务处，
工部局。
上海，1936年2月12日。
致 S 2，
请设法查明
一名名为霍姆斯的英籍报人
在1928年和1929年
在沪期间的身份及行踪。
据说霍姆斯曾在莫斯科、
柏林和伦敦为共产主义
报纸工作，且在沪期间
与中共圈子保持密切联系。
调查显示其行事极为谨慎。
JH
DS. 琼斯。
1936年2月13日。
